initial.title: B1 — Precision Championship
initial.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: portrait Watch-game visual CONCEPT, edited from the supplied final Direction B image.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. This user selected its cel-sports-comic style and explicitly approved the top and side surroundings. LOCK the upper skyline, moon, palms, buildings, lights, side walkways, HUD, characters, paddles, ball, camera, framing and all placements: reproduce them unchanged. Keep exact YOU 2 and BOSS 1 scores, the quiet centered progress ring and shield. No R or S counters. Do not enlarge characters or change poses; preserve their visible faces, bodies, caps/hoods, paddles and foot positions. Keep the bright lime ball in its exact position/size, its landing ring and the cyan plus cue. Keep the black margin below the near player.
EDIT ONLY THE CENTRAL PLAYING COURT: make this attention-dominant area feel beautifully authored and convincingly playable, rather than a flat neon wireframe. Do not solve the brief by adding more surroundings. Keep the same projected 20x44-foot regulation pickleball trapezoid and camera; exact outer corners, two kitchen lines 7 feet on either side of net, service centerlines from baseline to kitchen only. No centerline through either kitchen, no extra markings, no raised tiles, no optical illusions or changing the playable plane. Ball readability is paramount. Every surface treatment stays lower contrast than regulation lines, ball, characters and cues.
The net must be a believable LOW pickleball net, with slim posts JUST outside sidelines, fine dark mesh and a narrow top tape with subtle real center sag, not a volleyball fence or glowing laser. Preserve the same net crossing position. Substantial art-quality upgrade in court materials, net construction, grounding and edge finish, matched to the clean two-tone cel illustration. Do not add labels, title, watermark, border, mock watch device or comparison collage. Deliver ONE complete matched portrait image.
DIRECTION B1 — PRECISION CHAMPIONSHIP / BLACK COURT.
Create a premium tournament court through restrained sports craftsmanship and line/net material design. The entire empty playing surface remains truly solid RGB(0,0,0), with NO surface fill, ambient gradient, scuff texture, reflections or glows across the court. Replace the neon cyan perimeter and interior markings with crisp warm ivory painted regulation lines: flat on the floor, consistent physically plausible width, clean inked dark edge on only the outer-facing sides, tiny restrained warm/cool edge highlights rather than emission or bloom. Accurate geometry matters more than ornament.
Rebuild the simple wire net into a beautifully illustrated black woven sports net with a thin white fabric top band, barely perceptible sag, discreet tension straps and simple dark cylindrical post silhouettes. The band must remain slim and not cover ball/cues. The net and posts supply real depth. Remove luminous platform/halo appearance from the perimeter. Very tight muted shoe-contact anchors under existing feet, entirely subordinate to the feet. Result: high-end inked competitive sports court, clean velvety-black negative space, strong believable physical net and crisp white paint. It must feel materially different from the cyan hologram court without adding visual clutter. Preserve approved top and sides pixel-faithfully.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is Image1, the provided B2 Watch game concept. Image2 is the original B selected baseline for reference of exact placement only.
Change ONLY the playing surface material and net in Image1. Preserve the already approved skyline/HUD/side surroundings/characters/paddles/ball/camera and exact positions/scale. Keep all regulation line positions, two kitchen lines, service centerlines outside kitchens, and all corners. It is crucial to remove the texture covering the whole court: at least85%of the playing court must be clean solid pure RGB0 black. Remove every broad gray wash and every large bright sheen/specular patch. Retain only small localized low-contrast blue-gray material patches within a very narrow 10–20px band inside the outer sidelines and corners. These must never travel across any service box or kitchen. Quiet black void in the entire central court/ball lane. Do not just lower opacity of a texture over the whole court: REMOVE texture entirely across the entire central85%of the playable trapezoid. Keep the edges a subtle tactile matte charcoal rubber sports surface, without glossy wet pavement. This is the BLACK COURT OPTION, not gray asphalt.
Retain crisp thin slightly cool-white paint lines. Reduce the visible mesh to HALF its current height/depth, retain slim graphite posts/tension hardware and pale slate fabric top tape; fine low-contrast mesh should have broad open black cells at tiny Watch scale. It must be a real low pickleball net, not a tall tennis fence. The landing oval cue visible in Image2 just below the center of the net must remain visibly clear ABOVE the mesh as a small light-gray flat oval overlay at its original exact location/scale; this is a gameplay indicator, do not delete or hide it. Keep cyan plus cue and ball unchanged. Feet grounded through tiny local dark contact ellipses, no floating luminous pedestal. Do not touch any other area. No new text, label, title, watermark, border or device. One complete matched portrait concept.
